svg.title: Edit team panel, desktop: rename, changed agents, Save as a template, Remove team
svg.desc: The team panel open on the Docs team at /agents?team=Docs, being renamed Handbook. One agent is renamed (was writer) and open, with Name and Description side by side, the prompt across the row and the settings in two columns; one removed with Undo; one added (critic). The footer has Remove team, Save as a template (off until changes are saved), Cancel and Save changes. Insets show the team heading with its quiet text actions, the Save as a template form, the Remove team confirm, and the footer with nothing changed: Save changes off with No changes to save beside it.
svg.text: The same panel, opened from the team's heading (?team=Docs). Changes are a draft until Save changes. Words from copy.md.
Renames Docs: its agents and their tasks move with it.
Renames writer: it keeps its prompt, settings
and what it knows, and its tasks go on with
Outlines and drafts the piece for its…
One line. The coordinator reads it to
You are the writer of the Docs team. You outline and draft each
piece for its reader, in plain language.
- Start from the brief the editor set.
- Keep each page under a thousand words.
Its standing instructions, at the start of every turn. Tab moves to the next field.
Renaming doesn't change its prompt: it may still say "writer".
Blue. Agents can share a colour.
Checked by the team's reviewers. Its tasks
Model: empty for the engine's default.
What it may do without asking you.
Knowledge, where it runs and a taller prompt editor:
researcher will be removed when you save
Checks every claim in a draft…
Reads each draft as its reader would…
Entry: Edit team on every team heading
Every team opens here, built-in-made or yours
(see inset A). + Add agent opens the panel with
a new row added and open. No Start from here.
Checked like a new name. The hint says what moves.
The team keeps its template id, so features such
as Ideas stay on. Panel title stays the old name
2 · Rename an agent, in the open row
AgentForm's rename hint under Name. "was writer"
and "edited" stay on the row until you save, so
every change shows before saving. The open row is
New team's: Name | Description, the prompt across
the row (8 to 24 lines), then the settings in two
columns. Tab follows that reading order. The prompt
note says a rename leaves the prompt as it is.
A stub with Undo (a button) until save; focus goes
to Undo. If an unfinished task needs it, the save is
refused and the summary names the task
"new" until saved. Same row as New team.
Turns the footer into a confirm (inset C). Off,
with the reason beside it, for your last team.
Saves the team as last saved. With unsaved
changes it is off (aria-disabled, still focusable)
and says why in text beside it. Otherwise it
opens a small form in the footer (inset B).
One checked request for the whole team; on
success the panel closes, toast "Saved the
Handbook team". Off, with "No changes to save."
beside it, until something changed (inset D).
Fields are read-only while it saves.
INSET A · THE TEAM HEADING ON THE PAGE: TODAY'S QUIET TEXT ACTIONS, EDIT TEAM FIRST
4 agents · Writes and keeps the docs…
28px hit areas (dashed). Edit team comes first: it
is the common action. Names: "Edit team, Docs".
INSET B · SAVE AS A TEMPLATE, AFTER SAVING (THE FOOTER BECOMES A FORM)
Takes every piece of writing, sets its brief…
Keeps each agent's prompt and settings and which one coordinates;
not knowledge or where they run.
Focus on Template name. Its name must differ
from your other templates and the built-ins.
Success: toast "Saved Handbook to your templates
· Add it again from Add a team." Focus returns
INSET C · REMOVE TEAM, CONFIRMING IN THE FOOTER
Remove the Docs team and its 4 agents?
Their prompts and what they learned go too.
RemoveDialog's words. Focus starts on Keep.
Unsaved changes are dropped with the team. A task
that needs an agent refuses it, naming the task.
Success closes; toast "Removed the Docs team".
INSET D · THE FOOTER WITH NOTHING CHANGED YET
Save changes is off; the reason sits beside it on
button. Save as a template is on: nothing unsaved.
